title: Dropbox API v1 endpoints turned off
summary: Dropbox retired API v1 on September 28, 2017 and stated that v1 endpoints would return an error after shutdown.
migration_path: Migrate Dropbox API v1 integrations to API v2 using Dropbox's migration guidance.
user_impact: Applications still calling Dropbox API v1 endpoints stop working until migrated to v2.
